extracted.name: Favorite Things All Together!
extracted.description: These are a few of my favorite things to eat all together in one sandwich. Each sandwich weigh about a pound to a pound and a quarter. I started to call it the Belly Buster.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup chili I used spicy chili springtime see my recipe
instruction_lines: Heat two skillets. Split the hotdogs lengthwise but not all the way through and lay them split side down in one of the skillets.
Add sauerkraut on top with the juices.
Spread it out and simmer till the juices disappear.
Add chili to the other skillet.
Turn the hotdogs when there is no juices seen. Let the sauerkraut start to get browned
Cook chili till kinda dry and gets a bit of a crust about it. Just don't over char.
Turn the sauerkraut it should have all the juices out of it. Add on top of the splitdogs.
Put them together. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
